description:
Hushfeed v0.52.0 for TikTok 47.0.3

Morphe source updates work again. The source index used a timestamp format Manager couldn't read, which caused "The remote metadata file is unavailable." Refresh the Hushfeed source. Don't clear Manager data or change its signing key.

Comment tools now has a separate Hide search suggestions above comments switch. It removes TikTok's suggested-search banner above the comment count, while leaving comments and Hushfeed's optional comment-search box available. It's off by default and needs a restart.

Search settings now identify the screen they affect. The feed button, Inbox button, LIVE search, image prompts, search-page suggestions and searching within loaded comments have clearer descriptions. Poll hiding also explains that it covers ended results.

Verification: 1,490 runtime tests, 251 patch tests and both Android lint checks passed. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures, with no unexpected manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks; use 47.0.3 when patching.

The exact release-derived APK was installed on the S22 using its existing signing key. The suggested-search banner is absent with the new control enabled, and the comment count, close button and composer remain available. The signed-in account and original install time were preserved. The S25 source failure was diagnosed from its Manager log. Its TikTok installation wasn't replaced because its signing key differs from the local test key.

The downloadable .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Keep your existing Manager signing key when updating.
